sections.title: Items
sections.note: Kept through the Song of Time, though their ammunition and Rupees go. The Ocarina is in Main Quest.

items.name: Deku Sticks
items.howTo: Dropped by Deku Babas, and found in some pots and grass.

items.name: Deku Nuts
items.area: Clock Town and the Southern Swamp
items.howTo: Found in grass and pots, and dropped by enemies such as Mad Scrubs.

items.name: Magic Beans
items.howTo: In the hole at the end of the east side of the Deku Palace garden, the Bean Seller explains Magic Beans and gives you one free. After that he sells them for 10 Rupees each.
items.notes: Plant in soft soil and water with Spring Water or the Song of Storms.

items.name: Pictograph Box
items.howTo: Save Koume in the Woods of Mystery with Kotake's Red Potion, then talk to the guide at the Swamp Tourist Center.

items.name: Hero's Bow
items.howTo: Beat the lone Dinolfos guarding it in Woodfall Temple.

items.name: Lens of Truth
items.area: Lone Peak Shrine, east of Goron Village
items.howTo: Follow Kaepora Gaebora's feathers across the invisible platforms east of Goron Village to the cave with the Lens.

items.name: Fire Arrows
items.howTo: Beat the Wizzrobe in Snowhead Temple.

items.name: Powder Keg
items.area: Goron Powder Keg Shop, Goron Village
items.howTo: As a Goron, take Medigoron's test: carry the Powder Keg he gives you to the boulder on the Road to Goron Racetrack and blow it up before it explodes. He then lets you carry kegs, and sells them for 50 Rupees.
items.notes: Its first big use is the boulder on Milk Road that blocks Romani Ranch.

items.name: Hookshot
items.howTo: Get into the Pirates' Fortress (swim in as a Zora through the water gate) and beat the Gerudo Pirate guarding the room with the Hookshot's chest.

items.name: Ice Arrows
items.howTo: Beat Wart, the Great Bay Temple's mini-boss.

items.name: Light Arrows
items.howTo: Beat the Garo Master in the first half of Stone Tower Temple.

items.name: Bombchus
items.howTo: Buy a pack of 10 for 40 Rupees at the Bomb Shop, or find them in chests in grottos.

items.name: Great Fairy's Sword
items.howTo: Return all 15 Stray Fairies of Stone Tower Temple to the Great Fairy in Ikana Canyon in one cycle. The strongest sword, set to a C button.
items.notes: The Stray Fairies tracker has all 15.

sections.title: Equipment & Upgrades
sections.note: Each row's button counts upgrades in order. All of them stay through the Song of Time except the Razor Sword.

items.name: Sword

tiers.name: Razor Sword
tiers.howTo: Once the smithy's forge is thawed (Hot Spring Water from the Goron Graveyard, or spring after Goht), leave your Kokiri Sword with the smiths for a day and pay 100 Rupees.

tiers.name: Gilded Sword
tiers.howTo: Bring the Razor Sword and a Bottle of Gold Dust (first prize in the Goron Race) back with at least a day of the cycle left. The smiths reforge it for free overnight.

items.notes: The Razor Sword dulls back into the Kokiri Sword after 100 hits, and the Song of Time undoes it too, so forge the Gilded Sword in the same cycle. The Gilded Sword is yours for good.

items.name: Mirror Shield
items.howTo: Trade the Gibdos in the well the items they ask for (Bugs, fish, Milk, Beans and so on) to get through, and open the chest at the end.
items.notes: Replaces the Hero's Shield. If a Like Like eats your Hero's Shield, the Trading Post sells another for 80 Rupees.

items.name: Wallet
items.area: Clock Town Bank; Oceanside Spider House

tiers.name: Adult Wallet (200 Rupees)
tiers.howTo: Deposit 200 Rupees in all at the Clock Town Bank in West Clock Town.

tiers.name: Giant's Wallet (500 Rupees)
tiers.howTo: Clear all 30 Gold Skulltulas in the Oceanside Spider House on the First Day and talk to the man there.

items.notes: Whichever comes first gives the Adult Wallet. Finish the Oceanside Spider House on Day 2 or 3 and you get Rupees instead; in Majora's Mask 3D any day gives the wallet.

items.name: Quiver

tiers.name: Large Quiver (40 arrows)
tiers.howTo: Score 40 or more at the Town Shooting Gallery, or a perfect 2,120 at the Swamp Shooting Gallery.

tiers.name: Largest Quiver (50 arrows)
tiers.howTo: Do it at the other gallery.

items.notes: The Hero's Bow comes with a 30-arrow quiver.

items.name: Bomb Bag

tiers.name: Bomb Bag (20 bombs)
tiers.howTo: Buy it at the Bomb Shop in West Clock Town for 50 Rupees, in human form.

tiers.name: Big Bomb Bag (30 bombs)
tiers.howTo: Save the Old Lady from Sakon at midnight on Night 1, then buy it at the Bomb Shop for 90 Rupees. If he gets away, the Curiosity Shop sells it on the Final Night for 100.

tiers.name: Biggest Bomb Bag (40 bombs)
tiers.howTo: As a Goron, trade your Big Bomb Bag to the Business Scrub in Goron Village and pay 200 Rupees. Without the trade he asks 1,000.

items.notes: The Big Bomb Bag can be bought without the Bomb Bag.

items.name: Magic
items.area: Fairy's Fountains in Clock Town and Snowhead

tiers.name: Magic Meter
tiers.howTo: Bring the Clock Town Stray Fairy to the Fairy's Fountain in North Clock Town as a Deku.

tiers.name: Double Magic
tiers.howTo: Return all 15 Snowhead Temple Stray Fairies to the Great Fairy below Snowhead Temple in one cycle.

items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D the double magic comes from Woodfall's Great Fairy instead.

sections.title: Bottles
sections.note: Six on the Nintendo 64. Majora's Mask 3D has seven.

items.name: Kotake's Red Potion
items.area: Magic Hags' Potion Shop / Woods of Mystery
items.howTo: Find Koume hurt in the Woods of Mystery and tell Kotake (in the Potion Shop by day, in the woods from dusk); she gives you a Bottle of Red Potion for her sister.
items.notes: Needed to go on through the swamp, so it can't be missed.

items.name: Romani's Milk
items.howTo: Help Romani keep the ghosts away from the barn on Night 1, from 2:30 a.m. until dawn.

items.name: Madame Aroma's Chateau Romani
items.howTo: On the Final Day, bring the Special Delivery to Mama (from the Curiosity Shop owner, in the Anju and Kafei quest) to Madame Aroma in the Milk Bar.

items.name: Goron Race prize
items.howTo: In spring, blow up the boulder on the Road to Goron Racetrack with a Powder Keg and win the Goron Race.

items.name: Beaver Bros. first race
items.howTo: Hookshot up to the top of Zora Cape's waterfall and beat both Beaver Bros. in the ring race as a Zora.

items.name: Dampé's Big Poe
items.howTo: On the Final Night, use the Captain's Hat to have the Stalchildren open their grave. Below, lead Dampé to dig up the three blue flames, beat the Big Poe they form and open the chest.
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D this chest holds a Piece of Heart and the Bottle moves to Koume's boat archery.
